task: Build a unified autoregressive framework that decouples visual encoding to perform both multimodal understanding and visual generation within a single Transformer architecture
methodological_commitments: Decoupled visual encoding: separate encoders for understanding vs generation
Unified autoregressive Transformer backbone (next-token prediction paradigm)
Evaluation on both understanding tasks (VQA, OCR) and generation tasks (text-to-image)
Comparison with single-encoder approaches (Chameleon-style early fusion)
primary_quantitative_answers: Performance comparison: decoupled vs single encoder on understanding tasks
Performance comparison: decoupled vs single encoder on generation tasks
Trade-off analysis between understanding and generation capabilities
required_comparison_tables: Architecture comparison table (Chameleon vs LLaVA vs LlamaGen vs DVE)
expected_figure_families: Architecture diagram showing decoupled visual encoding
Semantic understanding demonstration using doge meme
